description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/news route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-news-directory.json
rules: Submit reporting about a specific, recent news event rather than a general topic or personal post.
Use straight news sources; opinion, analysis, advocacy, and press-release rewrites do not belong here.
Use an accurate, factual title that matches the linked article without editorializing it.
Link the original accessible source when possible; avoid paywalls, content farms, and copied reporting.
Do not repeatedly submit the same event, spam a story, or manipulate attention around it.
Keep discussion substantive and civil; no bigotry, harassment, personal attacks, or celebration of violence.
Do not expose personal information, organize witch-hunts, or use bots and novelty accounts to disrupt discussion.
